parts.tooltip: ma : IO a — a description of a side-effectful computation. Nothing runs yet; fixed when bind was applied.
f : a ⟶ IO b — user code; given the result of running ma, returns the next IO action; fixed when bind was applied
Execute the first recipe: its side effects happen now, producing a.
Apply f to the result: yields the next recipe, not yet executed. The choice of the next effect can depend on a.
The IO-specific join: execute the recipe f built. Its effects happen strictly after those of ma — order of effects = order of binds.

ports.tooltip: b — the result once the whole composed recipe has been executed by the runtime
